expected_timeline.event: Original meeting slot mentioned in the email (superseded by the update)

notes: Reschedule of an earlier meeting. The ICS carries SEQUENCE 1 and the same UID semantics as an update to a prior invite. ICS: METHOD:REQUEST, STATUS:CONFIRMED, SEQUENCE:1; timed event in TZID Asia/Kolkata with an embedded VTIMEZONE; 1 VALARM component(s). Email: multipart/alternative (text/plain + text/html) inside multipart/mixed, with this case's ICS attached as updated-invite.ics (text/calendar, identical to event.ics); In-Reply-To/References point to an earlier message that is not part of the dataset. No URLs, QR codes, images, scripts or macros are present. ORGANIZER/ATTENDEE values are mailto: address URIs, not web URLs. Received headers use reserved example domains and contain no IP addresses. All people and organisations are fictional.
